product_overview: A simple local/demo e-commerce web application allowing visitors to browse products, authenticate using a hardcoded test account, perform simulated purchases, view mock order history, and manage products via an admin UI. The frontend is a React app (TypeScript, Vite, MUI) with in-memory/mock data and client-side auth.
core_goals: Allow visitors to browse a product catalog and view product details
Provide a simple hardcoded email/password login to enable protected actions
Enable simulated purchases that add orders to an in-memory order history
Offer an admin UI to add, edit, and delete products during a session
Keep the app runnable locally with mock data and no external services

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with an in-memory hardcoded test account (example@gmail.com / 123456789) and redirect to the product catalog on success. Authentication state is kept in client memory and resets on page refresh.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Redirected to / -> View list of product cards
Navigate to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter wrong password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Observe invalid credentials error for wrong input
Navigate to /login -> Leave email or password blank -> Click Login button -> Observe invalid credentials error for wrong input

features.name: Browse Product Catalog
features.description: View a mocked list of product cards on the catalog landing page, open product details, and trigger a mock purchase flow from the catalog. Buy actions redirect to login when unauthenticated and show a success snackbar on mock purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View list of product cards -> Click View Details on a product card -> Navigate to /product/:id -> View product image -> View product name -> View product category -> View product price

Navigate to / -> Click Buy Now on a product card -> If unauthenticated Redirected to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Redirected to / -> Click Buy Now on the same product card -> See success snackbar after mock purchase
Navigate to / -> Click Buy Now on a product card -> If unauthenticated Redirected to /login -> Enter wrong credentials -> Click Login button -> Observe invalid credentials error for wrong input

features.name: View Product Details
features.description: Open a product detail page by id to view the product image, name, category, and price; from the details page the user can trigger a mock buy which behaves like the catalog buy (redirects to login if unauthenticated and shows a success snackbar on completion).
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> View product image -> View product name -> View product category -> View product price
Navigate to /product/:id -> Click Buy Now -> If authenticated See success snackbar after mock purchase

features.name: View Order History
features.description: Authenticated users can view a mock list of their purchases on the Orders page. Orders are stored in client state only and will not persist across page refreshes.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /orders -> View mock order list details
Navigate to /orders -> If unauthenticated Redirected to /login

Navigate to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /orders -> View mock order list details -> Refresh page -> Observe order history still present in current session until full page reload resets in-memory data

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Auth-protected admin UI where an authenticated admin/demo user can add, edit, and delete products in the client-side product list. All admin CRUD changes are reflected in the UI for the session but are not persisted to a backend and will revert on page refresh.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email in Email field -> Enter password in Password field -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /admin -> Click Add Product -> Fill product name field -> Fill description field -> Fill price field -> Fill category field -> Click Save -> See new product appear in admin list and on /
Navigate to /admin -> Click Edit on an existing product -> Change product name field -> Click Save -> See updated product in admin list
Navigate to /admin -> Click Delete on an existing product -> Confirm deletion -> See product removed from admin list
Navigate to /admin -> If unauthenticated Redirected to /login
Navigate to /admin -> Add or delete a product -> Refresh page -> Observe admin changes reverted (non-persistent client-only data)

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is in-memory only and resets on page refresh
known_limitations.impact: Sessions are not persistent across reloads

known_limitations.issue: Login uses hardcoded credentials instead of backend auth
known_limitations.impact: No real user management or secure authentication flow

known_limitations.issue: Product, order, and purchase data are mock-data driven with artificial delays
known_limitations.impact: No real backend integration or persisted transactions

known_limitations.issue: Admin CRUD operations are UI-only and not persisted to a backend
known_limitations.impact: Changes exist only in client state during the current session
